summary: Conduct research on the effectiveness of certain training elements and curriculum to change officer behavior and generate desired system outcomes; implement changes to training content, delivery and cadence as necessary.
question: How should the NC Department of Justice evaluate law enforcement training programs for effectiveness and desired outcomes?
statusOfData: Training data lives with the [North Carolina Justice Academy](https://ncdoj.gov/ncja/). The researcher(s) doing this project would help to develop a definition of officer behavior and system outcomes and measure those accordingly.
title: Law Enforcement Training Effectiveness
purpose: Administrative rule change by the Standards Commissions; local agency policy change; state agency policy change.
